inputs.style: Dark theatrical heavy metal, heavy distorted riffs, brief sinister organ accents, harmonic-minor guitar lines, expressive forceful male rock voice, powerful acoustic drums. 138 BPM, D minor. a baroque guitar motif contrasted with a brutal low riff; a long expressive neoclassical solo. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending. Extended instrumental development followed by two emphatic final chorus reprises.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Blackout curtain, dust in the beam
Wearing the mask, wearing the dream
The script is wet, the ink is red
A face that’s dead is sitting in my bed

[Chorus]
Thirteenth mirror, cold and glass
You watch me drown, you watch me pass
No curtain call, no final bow
The audience is stealing the show

[Verse]
Spotlight burns the stage to bone
The seats are full of faces known
They whisper names I never spoke
The applause is a heavy yoke

[Chorus]
Thirteenth mirror, cold and glass
You watch me drown, you watch me pass
No curtain call, no final bow
The audience is stealing the show

[Bridge]
The strings are sharp, the rhythm breaks
I look for an exit, but the light decays
The glass is cracked, the smile is wide
Nowhere left to run, nowhere to hide

The show is over, the trap is set
